 Date of Decision: 16.08.2023

Gurbax Singh and others ........ ...Petitioners
 Versus
State of Punjab and others ........ ...Respondents
Coram:
Hon'Ble
Mr. Justice Harkesh Manuja
Present: Mr. Saurabh Bajaj, Advocate, for the petitioners.

****
Harkesh Manuja, J.(Oral)

1.  By way of present revision petition, prayer has been made for issuance of directions for early disposal of the Execution Appliations filed at the instance of petitioners.
2.

Briefly stating, the land of the petitioners situated at Village- Lamba, District Jalandhar, was acquired wherein, award under Section 11 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter to referred as "the Act") was passed on 25.05.2007.
3. Aggrieved thereof, the petitioners filed reference which was decided by the reference Court on 27.05.2013.

Still aggrieved, the petitioners approached this Court by filing separate writ petition which was partially allowed vide judgment dated 07.09.2017 and amount of compensation was enhanced from Rs.24,000/- per marla to Rs.32,942/- per marla.
Based thereupon, petitioners filed three separate applications bearing Execution Application No.410 of 2019, Execution Application No.411 of 2019 and Execution Application No.412 of 2019.

The grievance of the petitioners is that the aforementioned execution applications are pending before the Executing Court for the past almost 4 years and the due amount of compensation has not been released in their favour.

sentences.text: Mr. S. S. Aulakh, AAG, Punjab, accepts notice on behalf of respondent-State.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and gone through the paper book.

6. From the records, it can be seen that the aforementioned execution applications are pending for the past almost 4 years and perusal of the zimni order dated 07.09.2022 (Annexure P-5) shows that since then the respondent No.2 is to furnish counter calculations.

7. Considering the fact that the issue involved in the present revision petition is about release of amount of compensation which finally stands determined by this Court, without commenting upon the merits of the case, the present revision petition is disposed of with a request to the executing Court to conclude the proceedings in the aforementioned three Execution applications pending before it, expeditiously and preferably within a period of 6 months from today.
8.
The present revision petition is disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
(HARKESH MANUJA)
JUDGE 16.08.2023 anil
